# Task: fix Wu's Node version probe so it matches the cwd the language server actually runs in

Repo: `dstrml/wu` (Zed fork, Rust). Local clone: `/Users/lilianda/develop/wu` (origin = fork `a1121611810/wu`, upstream = `dstrml/wu`). Upstream HEAD is `v1.5.0` (`a3ced28`).

Read this first, it contains the already-verified root-cause analysis and the upstream contribution rules:
`/Users/lilianda/Documents/Alma/2026-11-24/wu-eslint-node-compatibility/outputs/wu-node-version-probe-pr-prompt.md`

Then read the repo's own rules before touching anything: `AGENTS.md`, `.github/pull_request_template.md`, `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/10_bug_report.yml`, `.github/release/CHANGELOG.md`.

## The bug (do not re-derive it, it is verified)

Wu probes the system `node` with `node --version` in `SystemNodeRuntime::new()` (`crates/node_runtime/src/node_runtime.rs`, around line 938) **without setting a cwd**, so the probe runs in Wu's own process cwd. On this machine `node` on PATH is `~/.vite-plus/bin/node` → `vp`, a dispatcher that picks the node binary from a version declaration file (`.node-version` / `.nvmrc` / `.tool-versions` / `package.json` engines) found in the **current directory**, walking up to ancestors. So the probe sees `v24.18.0` (from Wu's cwd) and passes `MIN_VERSION = 22.0.0`, while the language server actually starts with cwd = worktree root, where `.node-version` says `12.22.12` → Node 12 parses `?.` / `??` and throws `SyntaxError: Unexpected token '.'`. Every node-based language server fails: eslint, vtsls, emmet, vscode-html, tailwindcss, json, yaml, bash, vscode-css.

## What to implement

Make the probe run in the same cwd the server will run in (the worktree root), so the dispatcher reports the version it will really use. When the detected version is below `MIN_VERSION`, the existing fallback must kick in: `ManagedNodeRuntime` (Node v24.11.0), which is already reachable because `allow_binary_download: true` is hardcoded in `crates/wu/src/main.rs`.

content.content:
# Changelog

All notable user-facing changes to Wu are listed here, newest first.

## Unreleased

- Fixed language server startup failure when directory-aware node shims (vp, nvm, fnm, mise, volta) report different versions per worktree. The node version probe now runs in the calling worktree's directory, so the existing managed-node fallback kicks in when the worktree's node is too old.

## 1.5.0 - 2026-11-22

- Add support Antigravity.
- Thinner, rounded scrollbar in the editor.
- Much lower CPU use while agents are working, and smoother long chats.
- Agents left idle for 15 minutes are terminated till the next message is sent.
- Faster Git refresh and commit history in large repositories.
- Faster search panel on files with very long lines.
- Fix Mermaid rendering issues.

## 1.4.0 - 2026-11-21

- Support git ops like cherry-pick, merge, and squash.
- Add tree graph to Git panel's History.
- Support Mermaid diagrams in markdown preview.
- Faster startup when reopening long agent chats.
- Fix long file names stretching PDF and image tabs.
- Fix terminal not picking up new env vars without Wu restart on Windows.
- Show "Open with Wu" in context menu on Windows 11 when the classic Windows 10 menu is enabled.
- Respect the system's dark or light mode in the Windows installer.

## 1.3.0 - 2026-11-14

- Fix the Git panel's History tab opening at the oldest commit.
- Add touchscreen support on Linux and Windows.
- Fix the search panel's action buttons doing nothing when out of focus.
- Show a Repositories list in the Git panel when a project has more than one repository.
- Reorder project tabs in the title bar by dragging them.
- Give files associated with Wu on Windows distinct icons.

## 1.2.2 - 2026-11-11
